operatorId.title: Operator ID (optional)
operatorId.description: Leave blank to let the plugin register itself as a remote on each device (it generates a UUID once and keeps it; this uses one of the device's 4 remote slots). Fill in the operator ID of your Smart M-Air app to mirror that remote instead; nothing is registered in that case. See https://github.com/JobDoesburg/homebridge-mhi-wfrac for more information.

ignoreConnectionErrors.title: Ignore Connection Errors
ignoreConnectionErrors.description: When enabled, connection errors will not be logged to reduce console spam when devices are offline.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often the status of each device is read. The WF-RAC module is slow and handles one connection at a time; 60 seconds (like the Home Assistant integration) is the default, 10 is the minimum.

name.title: Name
name.description: A friendly name for this device (e.g., 'Living Room AC').

mac.title: MAC Address (serial number)
mac.description: The MAC address (serial number) of the device, without separating characters (so denote 12:34:56:78:90:ab as 1234567890ab).

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Optional: client identifier sent with each request. The device accepts any string and the MAC address is used by default. Only set this if you want to mirror a specific value (e.g. one sniffed from the Smart M-Air app).

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: The IP address of the device on your local network.

hideDehumidifier.title: Hide Dehumidifier
hideDehumidifier.description: Hide the dehumidifier accessory if your AC unit doesn't support dry mode.

indoorTemperatureOffset.title: Indoor Temperature Offset (°C)
indoorTemperatureOffset.description: Added to the room temperature shown in HomeKit. The sensor sits in the unit's return-air path and reads high while the unit is off; use e.g. -2 to correct that. It does not change what the unit regulates on.
